slug: 2026-01-19 Ivory Coast Launches MaPoste to Digitize Postal and Administrative Services

systems.owner: La Poste de Côte d'Ivoire with ONECI
systems.tiers: national, by smartphone, for holders of a national identification number; request and tracking of civil status certificates, nationality certificates and criminal records, and delivery of identity cards; launched 2026-01-16

note: A postal application through which civil status certificates can be requested and tracked: a request channel for copies, not registration. Nothing on how offices register births or deaths.
